actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite

actions.desc:
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a piece of the bone breaks and sticks in the target's wound. The target takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as long as the bone remains lodged in its wound. A creature, including the target, can take its action to remove the bone by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The bone also falls out of the wound if the target receives magical healing 

A yek typically carries 3 (1d6) bone shards, which are destroyed on a successful hit. It can use its action to tear a bone shard from a corpse within 5 feet. Derro

traits.desc: The yek has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.desc: The yek has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the yek's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

ru.description: Среднее исчадие, мировоззрение: хаотично-злое. Класс доспеха: 16 (природный доспех). Хиты: 129 (16к8+48). Скорость: ходьба 30 фт., лазание 30 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 16, ЛОВ 16, ТЕЛ 16, ИНТ 15, МУД 13, ХАР 10. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, холодом, огнём, электричеством, колющего, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: отравление. Чувства: тёмное зрение 120 фт., пассивное Восприятие 15. Показатель опасности: 9. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 2, действий: 4.
ru.name: Алфа Ек
